name: Yuusha ga Ochiru Toki: Kyouran no Mitsu
original_name: 勇者が堕ちる時 狂蘭の魔蜜
source:
The protagonist called Thor Beleth is an ace adventurer in the guild.
One day, when he comes home after a quest, he finds that his sister 
named Eclair absconded from their house leaving a letter to him.
The letter tells him she is being involved in something bad and 
immediately drives him to go looking for her.
Will he be able to take Eclair back?

[Modified from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE222574.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角托尔·贝雷斯是公会中的王牌冒险家。
有一天，当他完成一项任务回到家时，他发现他的妹妹 
名叫埃克莱尔的人逃离了家，留下一封信给他。
这封信告诉他她正在卷入一些坏事并且 
立即驱使他去找她。
他能把Eclair带回来吗？

[修改自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE222574.html]DLsite English[/url]]
